title: the pre-tool gate refuses every revert of a path the phase may not write (git checkout --, git restore, rm, git stash push), so the observed-writes remedy can only be carried out by the operator
detail: Found building observed-writes (0.247.0). In building, gate._pre_tool_decision denies 'git checkout -- README.md', 'git restore README.md', 'git stash push -- README.md' (as writes to **) and 'rm new.txt'. The observed-writes per-call report and the advance refusal tell the agent to revert or move aside, which the gate itself refuses in that phase. Shipped wording now says the operator runs them outside the session. A sanctioned in-phase revert-to-baseline path, for paths whose baseline content is known, would make the honest path the easy one. Out of scope for observed-writes (pre-tool reader unchanged).
